title: Arsenal's 2006 final XI
brief: Name the ten outfield players who started for Arsenal against Barcelona in the 2006 Champions League final (17 May 2006), when they lost 2-1. The goalkeeper (Jens Lehmann) is left out.

notes.Manuel Almunia: Manuel Almunia came on as a substitute in the 2006 final, so he did not start.
notes.Mathieu Flamini: Mathieu Flamini came on as a substitute in the 2006 final, so he did not start.
notes.Jose Antonio Reyes: Jose Antonio Reyes came on as a substitute in the 2006 final, so he did not start.

checks: Starting XI, positions and shirt numbers from the team sheet on the final's Wikipedia page; the same eleven players and shirt numbers are on the Transfermarkt match report. Positions are Wikipedia's.
